Introduction

This week, I will analyze the metrics per window and then analyze the metrics with scatter plots, looking specifically at time stuff.

Data processing

Metric functions

source("../metric_functions.R")
source("../graphstat_functions.R")
source("../write_dtw.R")

Saved datasets

hsa_state = read.csv("../hsa_state_inc.csv")
dtw_results = read_csv("../all_dtw_results.csv")
hsa_dtw = dtw_results |>
    left_join(hsa_state, by = join_by(ID == hsa_nci_id))
write_csv(unique(hsa_dtw), "../hsa_vs_state_metrics.csv")
all_metrics = read_csv("../hsa_vs_state_metrics.csv")

Window dataset

hsa_unique = hsa_state %>%
    distinct(hsa_nci_id, state)
hsa_list = hsa_unique$hsa_nci_id

res = vector("list", length(hsa_list) * length(windows))
counter = 1

windows = list(w1 = c(1, 50), w2 = c(51, 100), w3 = c(101, Inf))

for (ID in hsa_list) {
    for (w in names(windows)) {

        bounds = windows[[w]]

        out = pivot_wider(dtw_stats(ID, start = bounds[1], end = bounds[2]),
            names_from = Metric, values_from = Value)

        out$ID = ID
        out$window = w

        res[[counter]] = out
        counter = counter + 1
    }
}

dtw_results_window = do.call(rbind, res)
dtw_results_window$window = factor(as.numeric(sub("w", "", dtw_results_window$window)),
    levels = c(1, 2, 3))
dtw_results_window = dtw_results_window %>%
    rename(peak_window = window)
dtw_results_window$peak_window = as.numeric(dtw_results_window$peak_window)

glimpse(dtw_results_window)

Ground truth

all_metrics_modified = all_metrics |>
  mutate(week_index = (epi_week + (epi_year - 2022) * 52 - 38),
    peak_window = case_when(
      week_index <= 50  ~ 1,
      week_index <= 100 ~ 2,
      TRUE              ~ 3
  ))

truth_peaks =
  all_metrics_modified |>
  group_by(ID, state, peak_window) |>
  summarise(
    # HSA peak
    hsa_peak_week  = week_index[which.max(inc_hsa)],
    hsa_peak_value = max(inc_hsa, na.rm = TRUE),

    # State peak
    state_peak_week  = week_index[which.max(inc_state)],
    state_peak_value = max(inc_state, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Differences
    truth_time_diff = hsa_peak_week - state_peak_week,
    truth_time_diff_abs = abs(truth_time_diff),
    truth_mag_ratio  = hsa_peak_value / state_peak_value,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

glimpse(truth_peaks)

DTW metrics by window dataset

    left_join(dtw_results_window, by = c("ID", "peak_window"))

ggplot(diff_peak_data, aes(x = truth_time_diff, y = signed_lag)) +
    geom_point() + theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~peak_window) + geom_smooth()
## `geom_smooth()` using method = 'loess' and formula = 'y ~ x'

timing_cor_table = diff_peak_data |>
    group_by(peak_window) |>
    summarise(cor_mean_abs_lag = cor(truth_time_diff_abs, mean_abs_lag),
        cor_signed_lag = cor(truth_time_diff, signed_lag), cor_lag_sd = cor(truth_time_diff,
            lag_sd), cor_frechet = cor(truth_time_diff, frechet),
        .groups = "drop")
timing_cor_table

Magnitude

diff_peak_mag = diff_peak_data |>
    filter(state_peak_value > 0, hsa_peak_value > 0, frechet <
        25, truth_mag_ratio < 5)  #, dtw_rmse < 5)
ggplot(diff_peak_mag, aes(x = frechet, y = truth_mag_ratio, fill = as.factor(peak_window))) +
    geom_point(pch = 21, color = "black") + geom_smooth(method = "lm",
    aes(color = as.factor(peak_window))) + facet_wrap(~peak_window) +
    theme_bw() + labs(fill = "Peak window", color = "Peak window",
    title = "Frechet vs. Truth")
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

ggplot(diff_peak_mag, aes(x = frechet, y = truth_mag_ratio)) +
    geom_point(color = "black", alpha = 0.4) + geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    theme_bw() + labs(title = "Frechet vs. Truth") + ylim(0,
    5) + xlim(0, 25)
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

frechet_lm = lm((truth_mag_ratio) ~ (frechet) * factor(peak_window),
    data = diff_peak_mag)

summary(frechet_lm)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(frechet_lm)

diff_peak_mag$pred <- (predict(frechet_lm))

ggplot(diff_peak_mag, aes(x = frechet, y = truth_mag_ratio)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4) + geom_line(color = "firebrick",
    aes(y = pred), lwd = 1.2) + theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~peak_window)

ggplot(diff_peak_mag, aes(x = dtw_rmse, y = truth_mag_ratio,
    fill = as.factor(peak_window))) + geom_point(pch = 21, color = "black") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", aes(color = as.factor(peak_window))) +
    facet_wrap(~peak_window) + theme_bw() + labs(fill = "Peak window",
    color = "Peak window", title = "RMSE vs. Truth")

magnitude_cor_table = diff_peak_mag |>
    group_by(peak_window) |>
    summarise(cor_dtw_mae = cor(truth_mag_ratio, dtw_mae, use = "complete.obs"),
        cor_dtw_rmse = cor(truth_mag_ratio, dtw_rmse, use = "complete.obs"),
        cor_rmse = cor(truth_mag_ratio, rmse, use = "complete.obs"),
        cor_amp_ratio = cor(truth_mag_ratio, amp_ratio, use = "complete.obs"),
        cor_dtw_amp_ratio = cor(truth_mag_ratio, dtw_amp_ratio,
            use = "complete.obs"), cor_frechet = cor(truth_mag_ratio,
            frechet, use = "complete.obs"), .groups = "drop")
